{PlayerFaction} — Internal Memo
{Date}

The situation has deteriorated faster than we anticipated. {EnemyFaction} moves through our outer systems with impunity.

This engagement at {SectorName} is not optional. We go to {MissionObjective}.

We do not know what they have in store for us. We put our faith in our commanders.

{PlayerFaction} — Encrypted Channel
{Date}

We are still standing. That alone is a victory.

{EnemyFaction} has taken much from us, but they have not taken {SectorName}. Not yet.

New orders: {MissionObjective}. Our commanders have not failed us. They will not start now.

{PlayerFaction} — Command Directive
{Date}

This is the last transmission before the push.

{EnemyFaction} believes us broken. They are wrong. Everything we have lost has only narrowed our focus.

The order is simple: {MissionObjective}. Nothing else matters.

{PlayerFaction} — Command Dispatch
{Date}

We began with nothing. We have clawed our way to this.

{EnemyFaction} does not yet take us seriously. That is their mistake. The {SectorName} sector is next.

Mission: {MissionObjective}. Prove to them — and to ourselves — what we are capable of.

{PlayerFaction} — Strategic Update
{Date}

They know our name now. {EnemyFaction} has begun to respond in force.

Good. Let them come. We have earned every system in {SectorName} and we will not surrender them.

Next objective: {MissionObjective}. We press forward.

{PlayerFaction} — Command Authority
{Date}

The galaxy watches. {EnemyFaction} is on the back foot and they know it.

{SectorName} will be the final test. After this — there is no question of who holds power.

All forces: {MissionObjective}. Make it count.

{PlayerFaction} — Operational Order
{Date}

This is not a war of survival. This is a war of ambition.

{EnemyFaction} holds {SectorName}. They will not hold it for long.

Order of the day: {MissionObjective}. We do not negotiate. We do not retreat. We take.

{PlayerFaction} — Field Directive
{Date}

The {SectorName} campaign proceeds as planned. {EnemyFaction} shows desperation.

Desperate enemies make mistakes. We will be there when they do.

New directive: {MissionObjective}. No delays. No excuses.

{PlayerFaction} — Final Directive
{Date}

One last push. {EnemyFaction} has nowhere left to run.

{SectorName} will be remembered as where we ended this.

All commands: {MissionObjective}. Leave nothing standing.
